title: 48 Barrack Street, Cappoquin, Co. Waterford
description:
this 3 bedroom end of terrace home in Cappoquin. The property is situated on the corner of Barrack Street and River Glen Drive and benefits from off-street parking with a garage.

The property comprises of porch, sitting room withlarge bedroom with built-in wardrobe, toilet/shower/WC, kitchen/dining room and conservatory. Upstairs there are two bedrooms.

The home has oil fired central heating

Located in the quiet, friendly town of Cappoquin this property is only two minutes walk from the tranquil Blackwater River and the amenities and facilities of Cappoquin. The beautiful heritage town of Lismore is only a 7-minute drive away and the vibrant town of Dungarvan is a 15-minute drive.Waterford is 50 -minute drive
